caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of cloth that is vertically oriented and colored in a uniform light blue. The fabric has fringes at both the top and bottom ends, made by loose threads extending from the edges. The main decorative feature at the center of the cloth is a large, symmetrical cross composed of small white geometric patterns that resemble a series of connected crosses and dots. The cross stands on a base that is stair-stepped and broader than the vertical arm, with similarly styled small white decorative elements. The blue cloth is set within a thinly outlined rectangular border in the middle of a larger plain, off-white background. In the lower right corner outside the main image border, the name "ELLEN DUNCAN" is written in small, black, printed letters.
title: Bookmark with Design of Cardboard
